instance origin: the dungeon and raid list marks each instance new in WoW: Forever or from the original game; the nine new dungeons confirmed by Warcraft Tavern's Forever dungeon announcement, the instance map IDs (2959-3065) by the client's DungeonEncounter table

points.name: Alcaz Prison (outside portal)
points.note: Portal in the cellar of the prison building on Alcaz Island, NE of Dustwallow Marsh (guide 75, 15; client tables 75.3, 14.1).

points.name: Tidemistress Ca'zass
points.note: First boss, straight ahead at the end of the main corridor, with two Strashaz Enchantresses.

points.name: Overseer Wrex
points.note: Left from the entrance; clear the three side cells first, then pull him away. He drops the Overseer's Keyring that opens the right side.

points.name: Katerina the Cleaner
points.note: Right side, behind the barred door, with two Alcaz Chaplain Priests. Commander Folkar is chained behind her.

points.name: Blazeroar
points.note: Largest chamber past Katerina; the guide also names Zarla Ober.

points.name: The Questioner
points.note: Locked door on the right of the entrance. Guide: skip him on the first pass, he is the real last boss.

points.name: Commander Folkar (Horde: The Honor of the Kor'kron)
points.note: Chained inside the dungeon behind Katerina. Position not sourced.

points.name: Mason Connery (The Man in the Iron Chains)
points.note: In a cell in Zarla's room. Position not sourced.

points.name: Overseer's Keyring
points.note: Dropped by Overseer Wrex; unlocks the right side.

points.name: Ornate Shackle Key
points.note: Guide implies The Questioner drops it; not stated outright.

strategies.text: He pulls the whole section, so clear the cells first and drag him back; the key drop opens the next area.
Priest adds heal her; kill or interrupt the priests.

notes: No coordinates inside the dungeon were found (journals and OpenMap have none for it). Order, entrance and key flow are from the Warcraft Tavern guide; another site disagrees on whether Overseer Wrex exists. uiMapID unknown for Forever-only dungeons. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
